categories.name: Resolve via timely payment
categories.description: Cases resolved through prompt payment by the offender, advancing the softgoal to maximize timely fine revenue and helping minimize administrative and enforcement costs, judged against time to fine dispatch and case closure indicators.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to declared alternative id=12 as supported by frequent variants such as V0002 and V0007.

categories.name: Resolve via delinquent payment
categories.description: Cases resolved through late payment after reminders and penalties have been applied, helping maximize timely fine revenue while balancing due-process rights, judged against average time to case closure.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to declared alternative id=13, evidenced by variants like V0004, V0005, and V0006 where payment occurs after penalty insertion.

categories.name: Resolve via administrative appeal to the Prefecture
categories.description: Cases involving an administrative appeal submitted to the Prefecture, preserving offender due-process rights at the cost of administrative expense and revenue delay, judged against time to appeal filing.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to declared alternative id=14, evidenced by workflow variants featuring appeal insertion, sending, and result notification steps such as V0008, V0057, and V00137.

categories.name: Resolve via judicial appeal to the Judge
categories.description: Cases where the offender pursues a judicial appeal before a judge, strongly making due-process softgoals while hurting enforcement cost efficiency.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to declared alternative id=19, evidenced by narrative traces containing explicit judicial appeal steps such as V0103, V0176, and V0140.

categories.name: Resolve via coercive credit collection
categories.description: Cases escalated to coercive collection due to non-payment, helping revenue recovery while increasing enforcement costs and negatively impacting due-process preservation.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to declared alternative id=20, supported by frequent high-duration variants ending in credit collection dispatch like V0001.

categories.name: Resolve via fine annulment
categories.description: Cases resulting in the formal cancellation and annulment of the issued fine.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to declared alternative id=187 as declared in the goal model decomposition.
